newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Nord Pacific eyes Canadian listing.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Nord Pacific eyes Canadian listing.

text.p: Copper and gold miner Nord Pacific Ltd said on Tuesday it may seek a listing of its shares in Canada.

Nord Pacific, which is listed on the Australian Stock Exchange, said it has lodged a preliminary prospectus with securities commissions in British Columbia, Alberta and Ontario proposing an offering of common shares in the company.
Proceeds of the offering would be used to develop the company's wholly-owned Simberi Island gold mine in Papua New Guinea and its Tritton copper mine in Australia, Nord said.
The Papua New Guinea property is estimated by Nord to contain 444,00 ounces of measured, indicated and inferred gold reserves
Tritton is a 50-50 joint venture with Straits Resources Ltd.
The property is located near Nord Pacific's existing Girilambone copper mine in New South Wales state.

The company said recently that measured, indicated and inferred resources at Tritton currently stand at 9.75 million tonnes, grading 3.01 percent copper, 0.21 grammes of gold and 11 grammes of silver on a per tonne basis.
Nord Pacific is a subsidiary of Nord Resources Corp.
